predictions.selection_reason: Removed entity decoding before protocol validation -> allows bypass of javascript: protocol filter via encoded entities
predictions.source_summary: URLs come from markdown parsing (reference links, autolinks, images) and are normalized via normalizeLink() which uses mdurl.parse/encode but does not decode entities
predictions.sink_summary: validateLink return value controls whether links are rendered as active hyperlinks vs. plain text
predictions.guard_summary: BAD_PROTOCOLS array blocks javascript:, vbscript:, file: protocols. Validation occurs after trim() and toLowerCase() but before entity decoding
predictions.risk_pattern: Protocol validation bypass via encoded entities - javascript: protocol can be obfuscated as javascript: or javascript: to bypass filter
used_variable_sources: url parameter from markdown parsing contexts
predictions.context_summary: validateLink is called after normalizeLink() processing to block dangerous protocols before link rendering
unresolved_facts: Whether normalizeLinkText's entity decoding was previously used before validateLink
Exact change history showing removed entity decoding step

retrieval_query.mechanism_summary: Improper neutralization of input during web page generation due to missing entity decoding before protocol validation, allowing javascript: protocol obfuscation via encoded entities.
retrieval_query.missing_control: neutralization of encoded entities before validation

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
top_sast_rules.description: Modifying an object obtained via a user-controlled property name may lead to accidental mutation of the built-in Object prototype, and possibly escalate to remote code execution or cross-site scripting.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Implement proper output encoding based on context (HTML, JavaScript, CSS, URL). Use Content Security Policy and validate input.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output
top_sast_rules.description: Reinterpreting text from the DOM as HTML can lead to a cross-site scripting vulnerability.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Detect output operations that lack proper encoding for the target context
top_sast_rules.remediation: Use context-appropriate encoding for all output operations. Implement proper escaping for HTML, JavaScript, CSS, and URL contexts.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of CRLF Sequences ('CRLF Injection')
